articles.title: Alberta Votes on a Big Question About Canada
articles.summary: People in Alberta, Canada, are voting on whether to hold a later vote about leaving Canada.

articles.title: Trump Wants to Rebuild a Public Golf Course in Washington
articles.summary: President Trump plans to close a public golf course in Washington for about 15 months to rebuild it, but a court case is still going on.

articles.title: Food Program Must Help Fewer Families in Gaza
articles.summary: A UN food program says it has run short of money and must help far fewer people in Gaza.
